instructions: Start each pass from a blank canvas. Do not import earlier annotations.
Use the same visible surface-opening convention and full visible segment each time.

Avoid consulting previous traces or predictions between passes. Take breaks as practical.
Preserve every pass, regardless of eventual agreement.
analysis: Evaluate each image separately using fixed geometry definitions and one common scale per image.
Report sample SD and covariance across five annotations, with four-new-only sensitivity.
Do not pool the three images into one universal annotation uncertainty.
Assess whether observed variability differs by image; differences cannot establish crack-appearance causation from three selected cases.
Retained originals and new passes have different session histories and previous prediction exposure. This is not a fully blinded study.
Sample variability does not estimate common boundary bias or absolute accuracy.
Use s for individual-annotation variability and s/sqrt(n) only conditionally for a mean of independent repeats.
